borrow.collateral-tooltip: The asset you deposit to secure your loan. Its value determines how much you can borrow and keeps your position healthy.
borrow.daily-interest-cost-tooltip: How much interest you accrue per day based on your borrowed amount and the effective rate. Gives you a real sense of the daily cost of holding this loan.
borrow.disconnected-description: Connect your wallet to view your borrow positions.
borrow.effective-interest-tooltip: The actual annual rate you pay after discounts. It's the base rate minus any rebates you qualify for.

borrow.has-position-title: You have a position already open
borrow.health-factor-tooltip: A score that represents how safe your position is. Above 1.0 means you're safe. If it drops to 1.0 or below, your collateral can be liquidated.
borrow.liquidation-price-tooltip: The price at which your collateral would trigger a liquidation. If hemiBTC drops to this price, your position can be liquidated.
borrow.liquidation-warning: Position at risk. Your Health Factor is {{healthFactor}}. At 1.0, your collateral will be sold to repay your debt and a {{penalty}} penalty will be charged to pay liquidators. <addCollateral>Add collateral</addCollateral> or <repay>repay now</repay> to avoid liquidation.
borrow.loan-tooltip: The amount of {{symbol}} you borrow against your collateral. As long as your Health Factor stays above 1.0, your position remains open.
borrow.ltv-tooltip: The ratio between your debt and your collateral value. If you deposit $10,000 worth of collateral and borrow $6,000 of {{symbol}}, your LTV is 60%.
borrow.no-positions-description: Deposit collateral to borrow {{symbol}} and put your assets to work.
